say:1:1530729001:1.text: Yes, she wrote all of them!
say:1:1530729001:1.male: Yes, she wrote all of them!
say:1:1530729001:1.female: Yes, she wrote all of them!

say:2:1530729002:1.text: She expects us to read them too, not just keep them organized.
say:2:1530729002:1.source_cn: 不止整理，她还要我们都多多阅读。
say:2:1530729002:1.male: She expects us to read them too, not just keep them organized.
say:2:1530729002:1.female: She expects us to read them too, not just keep them organized.

say:3:1530729003:1.text: I've read some, and there's a lot written about you.
say:3:1530729003:1.source_cn: 我看过一些，发现上面记载了很多关于你的事情。
say:3:1530729003:1.male: I've read some, and there's a lot written about you.
say:3:1530729003:1.female: I've read some, and there's a lot written about you.
